mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, sort_order FROM category WHERE is_enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, v.cover_url, v.play_url, v.source, v.remote_url, v.duration_seconds, v.published_at, u.id AS owner_id, u.nickname AS owner_nickname, u.avatar_url AS owner_avatar, u.signature AS owner_signature, COALESCE(us.follower_count, 0) AS follower_count, CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS owner_followed, COALESCE(s.play_count, 0) AS play_count, COALESCE(s.danmaku_count, 0) AS danmaku_count, COALESCE(s.like_count, 0) AS like_count, COALESCE(s.coin_count, 0) AS coin_count, COALESCE(s.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE(s.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, COALESCE(s.share_count, 0) AS share_count, COALESCE(h.progress_seconds, -1) AS watch_progress FROM video v JOIN `user` u ON u.id = v.owner_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN video_stats s ON s.video_id = v.id LEFT JOIN user_stats us ON us.user_id = v.owner_id LEFT JOIN user_follow f ON f.follower_id = #{userId} AND f.followee_id = v.owner_id LEFT JOIN watch_history h ON h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.video_id = v.id WHERE v.id = #{videoId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
